'''Hathox Greb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hrakian]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] living in times of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The captain of the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Niax]]'', Greb operated in the [[Commonality]]. He used a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]], a [[PAC20 Visual Wrist Comm]], [[Model TT4 Holorecording Macrobinoculars|Holorecording Macrobinoculars]] and a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]. He wore a padded flight suit.

A pilot specialized in [[Transport/Legends|space transport]], Greb was also a experienced [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] and spacehand, with knowledge about [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. He did not speak [[Hrakian (language)|his species' language]] but was fluent in [[Kilmaulsi (language)|Kilmaulsi]] and [[Paigun (language)|Paigun]] languages.

Unlike most Hrakians who were neutral about pangalactic politics, Greb was a zealot supporter of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. While Greb was doing his job, he was alert for criminal and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity, as he believed the Commonality was a throng of traitors. Greb hoped to discover a conspiracy, becoming a hero and getting access to better-paid contracts.
